note: Facilitator cases. Process them in order with ONE log (state carries over: ids seen, channel cumulative amounts). The log's clock is `now`. Before the cases, the owner's channel exists with the given deposit, and the mints and deposits in `setup` have been made. `want` is the outcome each case must have, written by hand; `expected` is the full SettleResponse.extensions.solidarity.info the log returns (null = no entry). Every core SettleResponse field must come back unchanged. Purchase payloads are placeholders: the log does not check them.

key.note: Hardhat/Anvil development account 0. Public. Never fund it.

cases.name: exact-accepted
cases.note: 48 USDC exact purchase at rate 0.001: an exact share of 48000 is accepted.

cases.name: duplicate
cases.note: The same id again.

cases.name: wrong-log
cases.note: log is not this log's URL.

cases.name: fund-not-allowed
cases.note: fund is not in the descriptor's funds.

cases.name: payto-not-fund
cases.note: payment.accepted.payTo is the seller, not the fund.

cases.name: exact-share-on-upto
cases.note: An exact share is allowed only with an exact purchase.

cases.name: over-rate
cases.note: rate 0.02 is above 0.01.

cases.name: bad-signature
cases.note: The share's EIP-3009 signature does not verify.

cases.name: expired
cases.note: validBefore is less than now + 6 seconds.

cases.name: below-minimum
cases.note: A 5000 exact share is below the descriptor's minAmount of 10000.

cases.name: amount-changed
cases.note: Signed 60000 on a 48 USDC purchase at 0.001 (48000): exact cannot settle less.

cases.name: batch-accepted
cases.note: 2 USDC purchase: a batch-settlement share of 2000 on the owner's channel.

cases.name: batch-next
cases.note: The next voucher, cumulative from the client's own state (previous plus the amount the log reported).

cases.name: cumulative-mismatch
cases.note: maxClaimableAmount is not chargedCumulativeAmount + amount. The snapshot carries the last voucher the log holds, for the client's resync.

cases.name: upto-settles-less
cases.note: Signed on a 10 USDC maximum (10000); the settle collected 4 USDC, so 4000 is recorded.

cases.name: purchase-failed
cases.note: No purchase, no share.

cases.name: escrow
cases.note: auth-capture defaults to escrow; draft 2 has no shares on escrow flows.

cases.name: echo-only
cases.note: version and logs echoed, no payment: no solidarity entry.

cases.name: pending
cases.note: The purchase settle returned settlement_pending; the share is held and processed when the purchase confirms.

cases.name: kind-not-listed
cases.note: The share's scheme is not listed in the descriptor for this network and asset.

cases.name: exact-to-not-fund
cases.note: The EIP-3009 authorization pays the seller, though accepted.payTo is the fund. The signature is valid for what was signed.

cases.name: exact-value-differs
cases.note: The authorization's value (50000) is not accepted.amount (48000).

cases.name: exact-nonce-not-from-id
cases.note: The nonce is not SHA-256("solidarity/2|" + id), so the signed payment does not bind the id.

cases.name: exact-not-yet-valid
cases.note: validAfter is in the future.

cases.name: terms-max-timeout
cases.note: accepted.maxTimeoutSeconds (120) is not the descriptor entry's (60).

cases.name: terms-extra
cases.note: accepted.extra carries a field the descriptor entry does not.

cases.name: network-mismatch
cases.note: The share is on Base mainnet; the fund and the purchase are on Base Sepolia.

cases.name: asset-mismatch
cases.note: The share is in another token than the purchase.

cases.name: batch-channel-id
cases.note: voucher.channelId is another (funded) channel's id, not the hash of channelConfig.

cases.name: batch-receiver
cases.note: The channel's receiver is the seller, not the fund.

cases.name: batch-receiver-authorizer
cases.note: The channel's receiverAuthorizer is not the log's.

cases.name: batch-token
cases.note: The channel's token is not the share's asset.

cases.name: batch-withdraw-delay
cases.note: The channel's withdrawDelay (3600) is not the descriptor entry's (86400).

cases.name: batch-over-balance
cases.note: The voucher's ceiling (2000) is more than the channel holds (1000).

cases.name: batch-withdraw-delay-out-of-range
cases.note: withdrawDelay -1 cannot be hashed as uint40; the share is skipped and the purchase's response is untouched.

cases.name: exact-pays-seller
cases.note: accepted.payTo and the authorization both name the seller, and the signature is valid: only the rule that payTo is the fund's address catches it.

cases.name: fund-on-another-chain
cases.note: The fund is on the allow-list but on Base mainnet; the share, signed to the same address, is on Base Sepolia.

cases.name: purchase-on-another-network
cases.note: The share and the fund are on Base Sepolia; the purchase is on Base mainnet.

cases.name: requirements-network-differs
cases.note: The purchase's PaymentPayload.accepted is on Base Sepolia, but the requirements it settled under are on Base mainnet.

cases.name: schema-only
cases.note: accepted.amount is "048000": a number BigInt still reads, but not the schema's form. Valid in every other respect.

cases.name: batch-voucher-stranger
cases.note: The voucher is signed by a key that is neither the channel's payer nor its payerAuthorizer.

cases.name: batch-payer-authorizer-zero
cases.note: payerAuthorizer is zero, so the contract would check the payer's signature with EIP-1271 if the payer has code; this log cannot check that offline and refuses the channel.

cases.name: batch-share-floors-to-zero
cases.note: A 1-unit share on a 999-unit purchase at 0.001: floor(basis x rate) is 0, so nothing is recorded.

cases.name: pending-batch
cases.note: The purchase settle returned settlement_pending and the share is a batch-settlement voucher: skipped at once with purchase-not-final, nothing charged, and the client's channel state stays as it was.
